title: Twickenham Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical locations, urgent treatment centres, and hazard guidance for Twickenham, Strawberry Hill, and St Margarets.
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 or 112 first. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: West Middlesex University Hospital, Twickenham Road, Isleworth TW7 6AF (from Twickenham station: ~30 min walk north along London Road and Twickenham Road, or bus 267 or H20 north). Kingston Hospital, Galsworthy Road, Kingston upon Thames KT2 7QB (from Twickenham station: bus 281 south via Kingston Bridge, or train to Norbiton). For designated Major Trauma care, the regional centre is St George's Hospital, Blackshaw Road, Tooting, London SW17 0QT. 2. Urgent Treatment Centres: Teddington Memorial Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre, Hampton Road, Teddington TW11 0JL (from Twickenham station: ~25 min walk south along Heath Road and Hampton Road, or bus 33 or 281). 3. Area Hazards: The tidal River Thames borders Twickenham, Strawberry Hill, and St Margarets; flood warnings frequently affect The Embankment, Radnor Gardens, and access to Eel Pie Island during high spring tides. The River Crane flows through north Twickenham with fluvial flood risk in Crane Park. 4. Supplies: Pharmacies and grocery stores along King Street, London Road, Heath Road, and York Street can provide drinking water, first-aid products, and over-the-counter medicine during power failures. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
